name: IP2332
description: IP2332 (英集芯 Injoinic) 単セル リチウムイオン 同期降圧 充電IC (ESOP-8、裏のパッドはGND)。ピン: 1=NTC 2=ISET 3=LED2 4=LED1 5=BAT 6=LX 7=GND 8=VIN。入力 4.5〜6V (5V用)、充満電圧 4.2V、最大 2.4A、効率約92%。充電電流 = 0.35 + 2.75 ÷ R_ISET[kΩ] [A] (1.4kで2.4A、2.4kで1.5A、4.3kで1A、ISETを開放すると2A)。3V未満は定電流の1/5でプリチャージ → 定電流 → 4.2Vの定電圧。LXから2.2µHのコイルを通してBATへ。NTC は 100µA を流して電池の温度を見ます (使わないときは 10kΩ を GND へ)。LED1 は 5mA の定電流で充電中に点灯、LED2 は満充電で点灯。スイッチングは平均化した動作モデルで、リップル・損失・熱制限・入力電流の降圧効果・異常時のLED点滅は扱いません。数値は概算

sim.name: IP2332
sim.text:
.subckt IP2332 ntc iset led2 led1 bat lx gnd vin
* IP2332 behavioural model (averaged synchronous buck charger, one Li-ion cell, 4.2 V).
* The switching is replaced by a voltage source on LX; control signals are in amps (1 V = 1 A).
Vone one gnd DC 1
V43 v43 gnd DC 4.3
V6 v6 gnd DC 6
V03 v03 gnd DC 0.3
V049 v049 gnd DC 0.49
V18 v18 gnd DC 1.8
V273 v273 gnd DC 2.73
V3 v3 gnd DC 3.0
V415 v415 gnd DC 4.15
V42 v42 gnd DC 4.2
V41 v41 gnd DC 4.1
V2a v2a gnd DC 2.0
V8m v8m gnd DC 0.00833
Vcl vcl gnd DC 3.3
* ISET: a 1 V reference through 1 ohm; the current in RISET sets the charge current, ICC = 0.35 + 2.75 / RISET[kohm],
* 2 A when ISET is open (RISET >= 120k). x = current in mA.
Sref v1 ref vin v43 SWC
Vr1 v1 gnd DC 1
Rref ref gnd 100Meg
Rm ref iset 1
Ex x gnd ref iset 1000
Vo35 ci0 gnd DC 0.35
Ecc ci1 ci0 x gnd 2.75
Sa ci1 icc x v8m SWC
Sb v2a icc v8m x SWC
Ricc icc gnd 100k
* NTC: 100 uA into the pin; the voltage tells the temperature (0.3-0.49 V warm, 0.49-1.8 V normal, 1.8-2.73 V cool)
Intc gnd ntc 100u
Dcl ntc vcl DCL
Rntc ntc gnd 100Meg
Ehalf ichalf gnd icc gnd 0.5
Sh1 icc ie v18 ntc SWC
Sh2 ichalf ie ntc v18 SWC
Rie ie gnd 100k
Sv1 v42 vcvn ntc v049 SWC
Sv2 v41 vcvn v049 ntc SWC
Rvcv vcvn gnd 100k
* the charger runs for 4.3 V < VIN < 6 V and a cell temperature that is not too hot or too cold
Sg1 one n1 vin v43 SWC
Sg2 n1 n2 v6 vin SWC
Sg3 n2 n3 ntc v03 SWC
Sg4 n3 on v273 ntc SWC
Ron on gnd 1k
Rn1 n1 gnd 100Meg
Rn2 n2 gnd 100Meg
Rn3 n3 gnd 100Meg
* pre-charge (below 3 V) is a fifth of ICC; above it the current is the smaller of the limit and the voltage loop
Ek ik gnd ie gnd 0.2
Sk1 ie ia bat v3 SWC
Sk2 ik ia v3 bat SWC
Ria ia gnd 100k
Eb cb gnd vcvn bat 60
Sma ia m cb ia SWC
Smb cb m ia cb SWC
Rm m gnd 100k
Su m u on gnd SWG
Ru u gnd 100k
* output stage: LX = cell voltage + 100 V/A x (reference - current), limited to 0 .. VIN, and never pushing back into VIN
Ecm cm gnd u s 100
Ed d cm bat gnd 1
Sc1 d c1 vin d SWC
Sc2 vin c1 d vin SWC
Rc1 c1 gnd 100k
Sc3 c1 c2 c1 gnd SWC
Sc4 gnd c2 gnd c1 SWC
Rc2 c2 gnd 100k
Elx ls gnd c2 gnd 1
Rsn ls ls2 0.001
Es s gnd ls ls2 1000
Sd ls2 lx ls2 lx SWD
Rlx lx gnd 100Meg
* the input current is taken equal to the output current (a real buck draws less)
Gin vin gnd ls ls2 1000
Riq vin gnd 1k
* LED1 (5 mA constant current) while charging, LED2 while full; both off at a fault (no blinking is modelled)
Eik10 icc10 gnd ie gnd 0.1
Schg1 on chg s icc10 SWC
Schg2 on chg v415 bat SWC
Rchg chg gnd 1k
Sfl1 on fa icc10 s SWC
Sfl2 fa fl bat v415 SWC
Rfa fa gnd 100Meg
Rfl fl gnd 1k
Gl1 vin led1 chg gnd 0.005
Dl1 led1 vin DCL
Rl1 led1 gnd 100Meg
Sl2 vin led2 fl gnd SWL
Rl2 led2 gnd 100Meg
.model SWC SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.001)
.model SWG SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=0.5 VW=0.1)
.model SWD SW(RON=0.17 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.002)
.model SWL SW(RON=100 ROFF=1G VT=0.5 VW=0.1)
.model DCL D(IS=1e-12 N=1)
.ends IP2332
